chain_words.nuance: walking slowly and relaxed, for pleasure
moving faster because of time pressure
moving quickly and often in a hurried way
running at full speed for a short distance

explanation: These words all describe moving on foot, but they differ in speed and urgency, from a relaxed stroll to an all-out sprint.

usage_notes.difference: 'Walk' is a neutral word for moving on foot; 'stroll' suggests walking slowly and relaxed, usually for pleasure.
